scientific_limitations: Deterministic scalar Beverton-Holt growth with constant intrinsic rate, strictly positive periodic crowding, and saturating responses x/(1+q x). Reverse-order spectral invariance is about inverse abundance; nonlinear sign classification is for three seasons, not arbitrary periods or observables. Historical priority remains provisional because the full texts of two close but differing articles were inaccessible.
title: A sharp three-season arrow of time invisible to reciprocal-abundance autocorrelation
